en: Fixed Read garbling UTF-16LE files with a byte-order mark, and Write dropping byte-order marks or silently converting Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK or UTF-16BE files to UTF-8 (now refused)
zh: 修复了 Read 读取带字节顺序标记的 UTF-16LE 文件时出现乱码的问题，以及 Write 丢弃字节顺序标记或静默将 Windows-1252、Shift-JIS、GBK 或 UTF-16BE 文件转换为 UTF-8 的问题（现在会拒绝）
